metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Relieve Upper Neck Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates simple exercises designed to provide both quick and lasting relief from upper neck pain.

These exercises target the muscles at the base of the skull, including the suboccipital group, focusing on both stretching and, more importantly, strengthening.

The video offers a step-by-step guide that’s easy to follow. For best results, try all the exercises and stick with the ones that bring the most relief.

No special equipment is needed—everything can be done at home, and you may start feeling relief in as little as 30 seconds.

Watch now and start relieving your upper neck pain today!
